BrochureContent.Content:
Redmond Property are delighted to present No. 60 Boroimhe Maples to the Swords property market. This attractive two-bedroom mid-terrace home is well presented throughout and offers bright, spacious accommodation extending to approximately 74.7 sq. m., making it an ideal choice for families and first-time buyers alike.

The ground floor accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hallway leading to a bright and comfortable living room, complete with an elegant feature fireplace and convenient understairs storage and kitchen / dining room at the rear.

Upstairs, there are two generously proportioned bedrooms, benefiting from built-in Wardrobes. Main family bathroom with triton t 90 electric shower  

Externally, the property enjoys the benefit of designated on-street parking and a private rear garden.

The location is superb, with a wide range of local amenities within easy reach including shops, cafés, restaurants, schools, crèches, gyms, parks, and sporting facilities. The area is well served by excellent transport links, with frequent bus services including the Swords Express, providing direct access to Dublin city centre. Airside Retail Park, Dublin Airport, and the M1 and M50 motorways are all just a short drive away.

This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a superb home in a highly sought-after residential location, and early viewing is highly recommended.

ACCOMMODATION (Ground Floor)
Please refer to floor plans for room measurements

Hall- hardwood door, laminate floor, leading to:-

Living room - feature fireplace with wood surround and tiled inset, laminate floor, tv point, phone point, coving 

Kitchen - excellent range of built in wall / floor units, tiled splash back, Logic Ideal energy efficient gas boiler, under stairs storage press, double glazed sliding patio door leading to rear garden 

ACCOMMODATION (First Floor)

Bathroom – W.c., w.h.b., bath, partly tiled walls, mirror, extractor fan, skylight window, Triton T90 electric shower, shower screen. 

Bedroom (1) front - built in wardrobes 

Bedroom (2) rear built in wardrobes, new carpet 

Outside – One designated parking space and ample visitor parking, small shrubbery. Private rear garden, walled and fenced, partly landscaped, railway sleepers, outside light, bin storage unit

FEATURES

Natural gas fired central heating 
Upvc double glazed windows 
Built in wardrobes in both bedrooms
Bathroom with electric shower 
Attractive part brick facade   
Wired for alarm 
Anual Service charge €473.71 p.a.
Private rear garden
Close to town centre, shops, schools and bus service

VIEWING

By appointment with Redmond Property (Swords)
